post.caption:
Is an insulated garage door worth it in Miami?

It depends on your garage. Attached to the house, facing west, doubling as a workshop or home office? Then probably yes. Detached and used for storage? Maybe not.

Insulation is a comfort and durability upgrade first: a steadier garage, a quieter door, panels that hold up better. It won't make the garage a cooled room, and seals matter as much as the R-value on the brochure.

The full list of questions to ask before you order is on the 305doors.com blog. Link in bio.
